_comment: Targeted logging config for the #462 F2 arm. Consumed via
logging.config.dictConfig). Root stays at INFO so the boot log keeps its
normal shape; ONLY the breakable-graph module drops to DEBUG, which is
what emits 'Break graph due to function: _moe_offload_fetch_step'
That line is TICKET_462 §3's SECOND, independent count of the 43
crossings/step -- the first comes from summarise.py's crossings/round.
Two independent counts of the same event is the point; a global
--log-level debug would deliver it too, but at the cost of drowning the
boot log in unrelated DEBUG from every other module.
